parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may differ for each API request.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Express Connect circuit.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the region ID.
